question: Why does Shiva preside over the unmanifest and bring forth the world?
premises: He brings forth the world by the command of Shambhu.
He is the cause of authority over the pure and impure streams.
inference: Shiva's cosmic activity over the unmanifest is authorized by Shambhu and establishes governance over both pure and impure streams.
plain_english: Presiding over the unmanifest, Shiva brings forth the world by the command of Shambhu, because he is the cause of authority over the pure and impure streams.
